_comment: The one lexer's tokens, as src/shared/live-console-grammar.ts reads each input: `cases` as an expression, `texts` as a text (a string's body with no quote), `scripts` as a script; `strings` is each constant as `quoteConsoleString` writes it. The phone's ConsoleTokens.kt replays these cases. Offsets are UTF-16 code units, end-exclusive. Regenerate with `bun scripts/gen-console-token-vectors.ts`.

cases.name: a path, a call and an index
a minus is never part of a number
a fraction needs a digit after its point
both quotes, and an escaped quote
known escapes decode, an unknown one keeps its backslash
an open string runs to the end
a backslash at the end stays
a string never passes its line
every operator
a comparison binds without spaces
a dict of a list of keywords
names take digits after the first letter
an unknown character is an error token
a surrogate pair inside a string, and outside one
only space, tab, return and newline are whitespace
a keyword must stand alone
an assignment reads as tokens
a semicolon separates statements
and and or are operators, as whole words only
cases.input: a and b or andrew oracle

cases.name: a hole in a string is lexed where it stands
a quote inside a hole opens a string of its own
a string inside a hole holds a hole
a hole's own braces nest
an escaped brace is no hole, and a lone closing brace is text
an open hole runs to the end and leaves its string open
a hole in a quoted string ends with its line, as its string does
a carriage return ends a quoted string too
an empty hole
a slash pair is two operators here
strings nest no deeper than eight

texts.name: a backslash before another letter stays
a lone closing brace is text
a dict inside a hole nests
a closing brace in a hole's string does not close the hole
an opening brace in a hole's string opens a hole of its own
a quote in a hole opens a string, which a line break ends
an escaped quote stays inside its string
a quote is text, and a line break ends nothing
a text's escapes are the braces and the backslash alone
texts.input: a \{ b \} c \\ d \n e \" f

texts.name: a quote in a hole opens a string
a string in a hole reads the quoted escapes
an open hole runs to the end
a hole in a text may pass its line, a string inside it may not
a surrogate pair before a hole

scripts.name: an if with an else if and an else
a comment line, a trailing comment, and slashes inside a string
a line break inside a bracket is a token too
a comment inside an open bracket
an open string ends with its line
an open hole in a string ends with its line
a hole in a string is lexed as an expression, never as script
blank lines, and a stray close
tabs, returns and no closing newline
a comment ends before its carriage return
a surrogate pair in a comment and in a string

strings.name: plain text is written as it is
a brace and a backslash are escaped
a double quote is escaped, a single quote is not
a line break, a tab and a return are written as escapes
a surrogate pair is kept whole
